content: The MST-kNN construction has been reported to be robust to the selection of the parameter $k$ due to the guaranteed connectivity provided by the MST BIBREF8 . In the following, we fix $k=13$ for our analysis with the multi-scale graph partitioning framework, but we have scanned values of $k \in [1,50]$ in the graph construction from our data and have found that the construction is robust as long as $k$ is nor too small (i.e., $k > 13$ ). The detailed comparisons are shown in Section sec:comparisons.
